services.title: Brakes
services.body: Pads, rotors and calipers are checked as a set and the worn ones come off beside the new ones, so you can see what was actually changed.

services.title: Exhaust and underbody
services.body: Up on the lift, where the rust and the leaks actually are.

services.title: Batteries, starters and electrical
services.body: Charging and starting faults are tested at the battery, the alternator and the cables before a part is sold.

evidence.text: Had to go next door to Napa, bought a new one and Andy changed my starter then wouldn’t let me pay him for it!!

reviews.author: Tony Stack
reviews.text: tried to change my cats myself bolts were crossed on and stripped and so i gave up. gave andy’s a shot and in 30 minutes new cats were perfectly installed. amazing service

reviews.author: Nathaniel White
reviews.text: Andy did a great job on a custom exhaust for my R53 Mini Cooper S. Tight space, complex bends, no problem. The welds are clean, fitment is spot-on, and the tone is exactly what I was after. Solid work from someone who knows what they’re doing.

reviews.author: Jason Crawford
reviews.text: I went there for what I thought was a rattle in my exhaust. In literally seconds, he determined my exhaust system to be free of fault. He then proceeded to properly diagnose the issue to be with my sway ends. We scheduled a day to do the repairs & I returned. Rattle gone. Highly recommend Andy.

reviews.author: John Williams
reviews.text: Went in to have some custom exhaust work done on both my truck and my son’s truck and they are the best in the business!! Fully welded exhaust no clamps and it sounds awesome!! When Andy finished mine he backed it out of the shop and my starter went out, engine shut off. Had to go next door to Napa, bought a new one and Andy changed my starter then wouldn’t let me pay him for it!! There are still some great people in this world, both Andy and his dad are living examples of it!! Great people that I look forward to doing business with for a long time!! Highly recommend Andy’s muffler and brake!! Thank you guys, Appreciate Ya’ll!!

reviews.author: Douglas Hoyos (Doug)
reviews.text: Great shop, owned by father and son! What a dynamic duo. They were super professional knowledgeable and kind. They took care of me and they’ll absolutely take care of you. Highly recommend this shop. Got my exhaust done for my Corvette there and talk about service! Thanks for everything gentlemen.

reviews.author: Jennifer Sanders
reviews.text: This is my go to place for car inspection. I have taken two of my vehicles there and each time I was a random pop up. I was in and out in less than 10 minutes. This is the only place I will go. The owner is a wonderful man and his wife also sales scenery scents. Clean inside and out I must say.

reviews.author: Dawn Wick
reviews.text: What a terrific place to have your car fixed! I'm a single female who went there by myself and the young gentleman who took care of my car, was extremely polite, very knowledgeable and never once tried to give me bs. He even was able to fix it for hundreds less than we originally thought! I will never hesitate to take my car back there! Same day service with a great attitude and huge smile! Thanks Kenny's Mufflers for a great experience!

reviews.author: Leslie Grigg
reviews.text: I loved this guy. He was friendly and he made sure to tell you what, when, and why. I listened to him tell others what still needed to be done or will need to be done soon. Not once did he try to upgrade sell or push for the jobs. Just told them what was needed and answered any questions they had. I showed up around 11:00ish and gone before 12pm. No appointment or even a phone call. The office/waiting area is clean and relaxing. As my dad would say: "He is good people."

reviews.author: Chip Nuhrah City of Shelby
reviews.text: Took my old beat-a-round truck to Kenny's for a new muffler and tail pipe. They did an excellent job, and provided the friendly hometown service you expect to receive. I was very satisfied with the quoted price as well. They've been doing business in Shelby for a long time and I have always heard great things about them. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Buffy Ough
reviews.text: Brought my car in to test catalyst converter and found out my car has 2. Thankfully it was the cheaper one to fix. They got it fixed and are very friendly and helpful. Very reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Cheltsea Gregory
reviews.text: I went this morning to have Andy and his team look at my van. I thought I had a bad catalytic converter due to a loud rumble and rattle when I would crank the car and turn it off. They said it was just some loose bolts that needed to be tightened up. They were very quick and professional! Great job guys! I appreciate you for not taking advantage of a single mother of 4 children!

reviews.author: Dianne Harrison
reviews.text: Brake pads and rotors replaced. Excellent service and price. He addressed my concerns. Andy now has a new customer.

reviews.author: AARIN JACKSON
reviews.text: Came in all I knew was my muffler was louder than usual. He pulled me right in and showed me exactly where it was coming from. I appreciate the honesty and price was very reasonable. I was in and out in less than hour. Thank you!

reviews.author: Sam Stephens
reviews.text: This shop replaced the exhaust system on my Dodge Challenger. They did an excellent job at a fair price and had my car ready on time. Also, I was really impressed with how clean and organized their shop is. A top notch operation that does excellent work at reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Skip Gumphrey
reviews.text: Update 1-23-20 Had Kenny and his crew do some more work on the Mustang for me and I’m just as happy as last visit. Quick project, but they handled it very well and got me on my way with an even better sounding Stang after the second round of modifications. Thanks y’all !!! 11/19 Friendly and professional service even though the job I needed done wasn’t what they would typically do for a customer. They had me happily back on my way in short order and my new Mustang GT sounds MUCH better now. Can’t thank them enough, and I wouldn’t hesitate to return for more work if needed :)

reviews.author: Carmen Smith
reviews.text: Andy is the Best! Listens to the customer. Made suggestions, because I wasn't exactly sure. Pays attention to detail. And does an over all Excellent Job Laying Dimes, when welding. I almost want to flip my car over when I'm driving so everyone can see his work.

reviews.author: Lucas Jones
reviews.text: They take care of you here... I was in town looking at a used car a few miles away from kenny's. I called and asked if they could do a "pre purchase inspection" for me. They took me in the moment I got there, and performed the inspection 20 minutes before they were closing. He looked over the car and gave me some advice. It's hard to find a mechanic that will take you in last minute and not make you feel like you are putting them out. They made me, my wife, and son feel welcome and cared for. I strongly recommend getting your car cared for at Kenny's muffler & brake.

reviews.author: Sarah Ross
reviews.text: These guys do truly excellent work for a fair price. Excellent customer service and trustworthy. They have always taken good care of our family. We highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Samantha Reyes
reviews.text: Very helpful. Always my go to since Valvoline doesn't honor first come first serve! I always go to Andy's!

reviews.author: janet tallent
reviews.text: Stopped by for inspection and to check out possible ac issue… inspection was completed quickly and professionally. Gentlemen checked under hood then stated ac may not be problem but possibly a pulley. He added that he didn’t do that type of work but recommended another locally owned business that could diagnose and repair if needed. Very friendly and professional!! Will return to this business. Thank you!

reviews.author: Chenita Bowers
reviews.text: Love their work. They use their own parts to back their guarantee. They are fast and professional. They will not perform an unnecessary job. I fully trust them and I am truly particular. A mechanic a single female can depend on.

reviews.author: craig smith
reviews.text: Awesome and fast job replacing catalytic converter. Great pricing! Dropped it off after lunch and got it back before end of business day on a Friday.

reviews.author: Jason smith
reviews.text: Though it says Kenny's Muffler, it's really owned and operated by Andy, ANDYS MUFFLER SHOP as I understand it. Customer service galore, I've had several of our buisness vehicles and 1 of my personal vehicles serviced by Andy, he understands small buisness customer service. Local small buisness can get overwhelmed quickly when u provide good service and quality work as it happens to me in the Locksmith Service industry, good to know our town has a good locally owned muffler shop that does great work. Thanks Andy

reviews.author: John Gallarini
reviews.text: Went to Kenny's to get a repair done on my daughter's van. Kenny and Andrew are both very knowledgeable and professional. Highly recommended for OEM or custom work.

reviews.author: VinnyBoy Wo
reviews.text: Great service and excellent prices. Surprisingly fast turnaround of only one business day for a full exhaust refit! Kenny's will treat you right!

reviews.author: Doug R
reviews.text: Fast, professional, and very reasonably priced. There is no other business in town that can touch Kennys Muffler. I would give them 10 stars if it was an option.

reviews.author: Justin Salo
reviews.text: Andy's Muffler & Brake is a great place to go for many of your automotive needs. Andy did some work on my exhaust system and I can't say enough about how good he is at what he does.

reviews.author: Dan Squidward
reviews.text: Great people got the job done, came in and got it done the same day . I told them it was the only car I had and couldn’t leave it and they work with me and got it done the price was fair. I would come back ina heart beat and would let friends and family know about this place.Thank you Mr. Kenny and the workers !!!

reviews.author: Paul Bukta
reviews.text: The annual vehicle inspection didn’t take much of my time. Andy had me in and out quickly. I appreciate his level of service.

reviews.author: Morgan Clary
reviews.text: Very quick service, fair prices, and excellent customer service. Couldn’t recommend Andy’s shop more!

reviews.author: Tasty Treat
reviews.text: They are nice. My service was handled quickly. I wish they offered more options but they do well with what they provide.

reviews.author: Amanda Reth
reviews.text: Very good. Was surprised they were so fast and reasonable. Got me back on the road quick. Not remotely rude at all

reviews.author: Mark Baity
reviews.text: Great price and service! Will use again. My exhaust sounds awesome and they were very helpful with selection

reviews.author: David Sparks
reviews.text: Very friendly, fast and knowledgeable. The building is clean and organized. He has been in uptown Shelby for decades.

reviews.author: Karen Nelson
reviews.text: Highly recomend Andy's Muffler &Brake Shop. Got right in to get vehicles inspected and some minor fix to pass said inspection Very friendly staff!

reviews.author: Travis Odoms
reviews.text: I WOULD HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS SHOP!!! THE GUYS HERE ARE GREAT AND THEY REALLY TOOK THEIR TIME TO MODIFY SOME WORK ON MY CAR!!! KENNY WAS GREAT WITH CUSTOMER SERVICE!! THANKS KENNY!!!

reviews.author: Roger One
reviews.text: Kenny did great work on my old ford F- 150 truck he and I had a great talk about respect I would tell anyone with problems with your car or truck go see Kenny's Muffler & Brake. Thank you Kenny Charles Degree

reviews.author: Lindsey Sebastian
reviews.text: Super quick in and out service. Love that they didn't try to push unneccessary services on me, they completed what needed to be done and I was on my way.

reviews.author: michael lynch
reviews.text: Honest, professional work. You can trust Kenny to do what is needed, fix it properly, and charge you a fair price. What more can you ask.

reviews.author: MaryRose Hastings
reviews.text: I would have every single maintenence and repair item done here if I could. Incredible, top notch service.

reviews.author: Jeannie King
reviews.text: They refused to do work for me if I didnt buy their products insead of the more reasonable parts I bought. They are greedy jerks.

reviews.author: Jermaine Kelly
reviews.text: People really good and know what they are doing I recommend anyone need muffler's or any exhaust work, this is the place..

reviews.author: Marcia Mullins
reviews.text: Needed an inspection before I bought my sticker and renewed my registration. I was in and out in 15 minutes.

reviews.author: annoymous person
reviews.text: Rude to the customers and disrespectful! will never recommend his business to anyone, and we could have gave a bunch of business!!!!!!!
